topology_receipt.rule: Exclude every whole track containing a source anchor used more than once; all train and reserve observations audited; no score, signal strength, receiver position, or satellite criteria.

protocol.inventory: per prior: saved D minimum, saved mean selection, saved mixture selection; coincident physical coordinates evaluated once; plus one roof reference per scan
protocol.evaluation: each physical coordinate is an independent origin with zero offset and a fresh Doppler shortlist
protocol.truth_use: operator-supplied WGS84 roof reference is diagnostic only and never an estimator input or candidate source

roof_reference.role: independent diagnostic only; not compared or shared with either prior's selected candidates
